method: Native64 PNG samples with alpha>=230; sRGB weighted luminance (diagnostic, not physical linear light); HSV saturation; exact RGB 4-connected cluster counting.
limitations: Golden40 exports contain resampling/JPEG-derived matte artifacts. Color counts and singleton clusters cannot be treated as a Golden target.
Different objects and material proportions make aggregate distributions descriptive only.
Metrics do not prove style, object correctness, originality or visual approval.
